description: Find Claude Code sessions tracked by the Agent Monitor by project (cwd), model, status, or date, then rank the matches by cost or recency. Pulls the session list and the distinct cwd / facet values so filters use real values rather than guesses. Use when locating a session — "find my EstateWise sessions", "which Opus runs errored this week", "most expensive sessions in /repo".
